summary: Validate pinned Docs 0.5 adoption without forcing a downgrade

delivery.outcome: Recognize the published Docs 0.5 adoption used by C2004 and retain exact revision/digest/repository validation; publish through the independent Validator.
nonGoals: Changing C2004 history gate or writing in its occupied checkout

architecture.decision: Allow only explicit published revision/hash pairs with unchanged exact repository-bound adoption record checks. Use Docs 0.5 for new adoption records; retain the previous pinned revision for compatibility.
architecture.rollback: Revert this change; adoption files remain untouched.

validation.evidence: Published current/legacy pairs accepted; wrong repository, hashes, unknown pins and malformed records rejected.
Full tests and governance pass; C2004 Docs adoption accepted without rewriting its policy.
